?Daniel 7:22 MSG

But then The Old One intervened and decided things in favor of the people of the High God. In the end, God’s holy people took over the kingdom.?The Ancient of days will once again intervene to turn things in your favour.?He has the final say in all situations. Do not give in to any negative report. ?The doctor don’t have the final say and neither do the financial experts or those in authority above you.?Today, He will super impose the super upon the natural and decide once again things in your favour in Jesus name✔????????R.E.M.I.N.D.E.R.Feb.
